name: Storm Burger
facts: Two open locations: Inglewood (1500 N La Brea Ave) and Long Beach (5801 Cherry Ave). Compton (336 W Alondra Blvd) is coming soon.
Inglewood hours: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM.
Long Beach hours: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.
Rewards: 20 points per $1 spent.
Reward ladder: 1,000 pts free fries, 1,800 free shake, 3,000 free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 free combo.
Bonus points: 50 for a QR check-in visit, 100 first order, 200 birthday, 250 for in-app feedback.
Storm Run is a free driving game: 10 levels, 90 seconds each, 5 lives.
Each hit costs half a life, so 10 hits end the run.
Coins are worth +10 points each.
Food pickups: Classic StormBurger +60, Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich +50, Chicken Strips +50, Shake +40, Lemonade +40, Fries +30, Onion Rings +30.
Game prizes (sample): 400 pts free house sauce, 600 free fries or onion rings, 800 free milkshake, 1,000 free Classic StormBurger.
Weekly top score wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo. The board resets every Monday and closes Sunday 11 PM.
Game prizes must be used within 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time.
You can play Storm Run free with no account. You need a free member account to save a score or prize.
Free daily spin: one per member per day, every slice wins something.
Spin and food prizes are good for 3 days at either location, one per visit, and can't be combined.
Combos include fries and a soft drink. Onion rings or a milkshake upgrade is +$2.00 each.
Sauces are homemade, $1.00 each.
Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99, Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99.
Order from the Order Inglewood and Order Long Beach buttons in the app.
You can build your own burger or chicken sandwich in the app.
Language menu (🌐) includes English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
For help, ask at the counter. No phone number is shown in the app.
Instagram: @stormburger
suggested: How do I play Storm Run?
What prizes can I win in the game?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM. Long Beach: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: What time does Inglewood open and close?
qa.a: Inglewood is open Sun–Thu 10:30 AM to 12 AM, and Fri–Sat 10:30 AM to 1 AM.

qa.q: What time does Long Beach open and close?
qa.a: Long Beach is open Mon–Wed 10:30 AM to 10 PM, and Thu–Sun 10:30 AM to 11 PM.

qa.q: Are you open late?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sun–Thu and 1 AM Fri–Sat. Long Beach closes at 10 PM Mon–Wed and 11 PM Thu–Sun.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Fri–Sat until 1 AM and Sunday until 12 AM. Long Beach is open Sat and Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Compton (336 W Alondra Blvd) is coming soon.

qa.q: What is the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What is the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Is there a Compton location?
qa.a: Compton is coming soon, at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. It isn't open yet, and I don't have an opening date.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the 📍 Directions button under the location you want in the app. The "how close are you" map also has a Directions link.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: I don't see a phone number in the app. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do you have a drive-thru?
qa.a: I don't have drive-thru details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards club?
qa.a: Join StormBurger Rewards in the app with your name, phone number and email. It's free, with one account per person and phone.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, a member account is free.

qa.q: Do I have to sign up to play the game?
qa.a: No. You can play Storm Run free with no account. You only need an account to save your score or claim a prize after a run.

qa.q: What do I need to make an account?
qa.a: Your name, phone number and email. The account is tied to the phone you made it on, and the live app confirms your number with a text code.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free member account per person and per phone.

qa.q: How old do I need to be?
qa.a: The game rules say you must be 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: I lost my account or got a new phone. What now?
qa.a: If your number is already a member, the app lets you sign back in on the new phone. If you get stuck, ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier when you buy, and you earn 20 points per $1. You also get bonus points for check-ins, your first order, your birthday, feedback and referrals.

qa.q: How many points per dollar?
qa.a: 20 points for every $1 you spend.

qa.q: How many points do I get for $10?
qa.a: $10 earns 200 points, at 20 points per $1.

qa.q: Do I get points for visiting?
qa.a: Yes. Showing your QR for a visit gives a 50-point check-in bonus, once per day.

qa.q: Is there a first-order bonus?
qa.a: Yes, your first order earns a 100-point bonus.

qa.q: How do I get points at the register?
qa.a: Show your QR code or 4-digit code to the cashier, or type the code from your receipt in the app.

qa.q: Do I earn points on game scores?
qa.a: Not as a points ratio. Game prizes are food rewards based on your score. Your Daily Spin can award bonus points, though.

qa.q: What can I get with my points?
qa.a: 1,000 pts = Free fries. 1,800 pts = Free shake. 3,000 pts = Free Classic StormBurger. 4,500 pts = Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points. At 20 points per $1, that's about $50 spent.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free Classic StormBurger?
qa.a: 3,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open your rewards in the app and choose the reward you've earned enough points for. Show the code on your phone at the counter. Rewards are one per visit and can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have any expiration details for points. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do points have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: Yes. The app has member levels based on how many times you visit in a month (Member, Regular, VIP and Legend). Check the rewards card in the app for what you've reached and what's next.

qa.q: Do you have a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes. Add your birthday to your account to get a 200-point birthday bonus.

qa.q: Can I get points for leaving feedback?
qa.a: Yes. Feedback you send in the app earns 250 points. Google reviews don't earn points.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Share your code with a friend. You earn 150 points when they join, 100 more on their first order, and 25 on each order after. Your friend gets free fries.

qa.q: What does my friend get if I refer them?
qa.a: Your friend gets free fries when they join with your referral.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby?
qa.a: Yes. When you're within about 2 miles, the app can give you a heads-up. Show it at the counter for double stars on today's order.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something, from bonus points to a free item.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: One spin per member per day, based on Los Angeles time.

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. The spin is always free, can't be bought and doesn't need a purchase.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: Odds per spin: +100 points 30%, +200 points 20%, +150 points 15%, free house sauce 15%, $2 off any burger 8%, free fries 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long are spin prizes good for?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at either location, one reward per visit. They can't be combined and have no cash value.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: Storm Run is StormBurger's free driving game. You drive a food truck from Inglewood to Long Beach, grabbing coins and food and dodging the storm, for prizes.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Swipe left or right to slide between lanes, or tap a side to move one lane. Grab coins and food for points and dodge lightning, cows, stop signs, police and tornadoes.

qa.q: What are the game controls?
qa.a: On a phone: swipe left or right, or tap a side of the road. On a computer: the ◀ ▶ arrow keys. A game controller also works, using the stick or D-pad.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: A run has 10 levels of 90 seconds each. The first 10 seconds are calm so you can get the feel of the controls.

qa.q: How many lives do I have?
qa.a: You have 5 lives. Each hit costs half a life, so 10 hits total end the run.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Coins are +10. Food is +30 to +60. Each level you beat gives a bonus of 100 times the level number. Hazards take points away.

qa.q: How many points is each food worth in the game?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger +60, Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich +50, Chicken Strips +50, Vanilla Shake +40, Lemonade +40, Fries +30, Onion Rings +30. Coins are +10.

qa.q: What should I dodge in the game?
qa.a: Lightning (move off the glowing target), police cars (▲ arrows show their lane), flying cows, stop signs and tornadoes (stay out of the red lane). Cows, stop signs, lightning and police each cost half a life. Stop signs, cows and lightning also cost 100 points.

qa.q: What happens if a tornado hits me?
qa.a: A tornado costs half a life and a chunk of score, at least 200 points or about a quarter of your score. A TORNADO WARNING and a red lane show up first.

qa.q: What is the Jordan High pit stop?
qa.a: On levels 2, 6 and 9 you can pull into the Jordan High pit stop on the right. You build burgers by tapping ingredients in the ticket's order. Each burger is +75 points and repairs the truck by 1 life, up to 5.

qa.q: What are Antidote Drizzle coins?
qa.a: They're special gold emblems worth +25 each. Catch 5 and a review billboard appears. Drive through its golden ▶ for a +500 bonus.

qa.q: What can I win in the game?
qa.a: Sample prizes by single-run score: 400 = free house sauce, 600 = free fries or onion rings (with any order), 800 = free milkshake, 1,000 = free Classic StormBurger. The weekly top score wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: What score do I need for a free burger?
qa.a: Score 1,000 points or more in one run for a Free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: What score do I need for a free milkshake?
qa.a: Score 800 or more in one run. The shake is vanilla, chocolate or mix.

qa.q: What score do I need for free fries?
qa.a: Score 600 or more in one run for free fries or an upgrade to onion rings, with any order.

qa.q: What score do I need for a free sauce?
qa.a: Score 400 or more in one run for a free house sauce. Storm, Thunder, Ranch and more, your pick.

qa.q: Are the game prizes real?
qa.a: The prizes shown are samples, and StormBurger picks the real ones. Prizes depend only on your score, not on chance.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: After your run, save the prize to your rewards. Join or sign in if asked. Then show the code on your phone at StormBurger to redeem.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a game prize?
qa.a: 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time, so use it before your next win saves.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins the weekly prize. The board resets every Monday. Ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo for the top score by Sunday close.

qa.q: When does the weekly contest end?
qa.a: Sunday close. The app's countdown says the week's board closes Sunday at 11:00 PM, and it resets on Monday.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The top score at Sunday close wins. The board resets Monday. I don't have an exact pickup day, so please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I get on the leaderboard?
qa.a: Play a run, then save your score with a free member account (name, phone, email).

qa.q: Where can I see my best score?
qa.a: The game shows "Your best" on this phone, saved locally.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. Storm Run is free with no limits right now.

qa.q: Do I need to buy something to play?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Do game tokens exist?
qa.a: Tokens are not turned on right now, so Storm Run is simply free. If tokens ever start, the app will tell you how they work.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members may play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: What are the official game rules?
qa.a: Tap "Game & daily spin official rules" in the app. The rules page is marked as a draft, so ask staff for anything you're unsure about.

qa.q: Is there music or sound in the game?
qa.a: Yes. Use the 🔊 Sound button to turn sound on or off. There are two songs, Energy and Cheat Code, and the 🎵 button switches songs.

qa.q: Can I change how the game looks?
qa.a: Yes. In Settings you can switch between the 3D chase cam and Classic 2D, and pick a Graphics level. Smooth is recommended for phones.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro and similar controllers work in most browsers. Use the stick or D-pad to change lanes.

qa.q: What is the halftime video?
qa.a: During play you may see a short break with clips of Antidote The Foodie's review of StormBurger. You can skip it or watch the full review on YouTube.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Combos, burgers, a Kids Burger and Kids Combo, a Turkey Burger, a chicken sandwich, shakes, sides like fries and onion rings, and homemade sauces. Check the Menu section of the app for the full list.

qa.q: What combos do you have?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99 and Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99. All come with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: What comes with a combo?
qa.a: Fries and a soft drink. You can upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00 and the drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: $6.99. It has homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños.

qa.q: What's on the Turkey Burger?
qa.a: $6.99. Two 2oz turkey patties, lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu?
qa.a: Yes. The Kids Burger is $5.99 (4oz patty, American cheese). The Kids Combo is $11.99 with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: How much is a shake?
qa.a: The Mix Shake ("Why not both?") is $4.99. Vanilla and chocolate shakes are on the menu too. I only see the Mix Shake price.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade sauces at $1.00 each, including Storm, BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo. Thunder, Ranch and Avocado Crema are mentioned too.

qa.q: Do you have chicken?
qa.a: Yes. There's a hand-breaded chicken sandwich (Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99), a spicy Thunder version, and chicken strips.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. The "Build your burger" section lets you add patties, cheese, bacon, jalapeños, onion straws and fresh toppings, and watch the price. Then you place the order.

qa.q: How much do toppings cost in the builder?
qa.a: The smash burger base is $2.74 (brioche bun and Storm sauce). Each patty is $2.50, bacon $2.00, American or Swiss $0.75, jalapeños $1.00. Lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and onion straws are free.

qa.q: Can I build a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes, using the "Chicken sandwich" tab in the builder. The base is $2.00, a crispy fillet is $4.99 and a spicy Thunder fillet is $4.99. Kale slaw and Swiss are $0.50.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: Yes, seasonal specials run on set dates: Thanksgiving Gobble Burger (Turkey Burger + Onion Rings, Nov 20–28), Holiday Shake Stack (Dec 15–25), New Year BBQ Combo (Dec 29–Jan 1), plus Valentine's, St. Patrick's, Cinco and July 4 specials.

qa.q: What is the Thanksgiving special?
qa.a: The Gobble Burger is a Turkey Burger plus Onion Rings, available Nov 20–28.

qa.q: Do you have a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: Tap Order Inglewood or Order Long Beach at the top of the app. You can also build a burger in the app and place the order.

qa.q: Can I order from my table or scan a QR code?
qa.a: Yes. Scan the QR code to open the app, then order. At the counter, show your member QR to earn points.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do you deliver?
qa.a: I don't have delivery details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Can I use a discount with another reward?
qa.a: No. Food prizes and discounts can't be combined with other rewards, and you get one reward per visit.

qa.q: Are there alcohol rewards?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 pill to choose English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย or Русский. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have details on a kid mode. The menu does have a Kids Burger and Kids Combo, and players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission for the game.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: On iPhone Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android Chrome, tap Install app or the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen. There's also an "Add to Home Screen" link in the app.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have wallet card details. You can add the app to your Home Screen for one-tap access to your rewards.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, there's a Write a Google review button in the app. Reviews don't earn points or prizes, and honest reviews only please.

qa.q: Do you have Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, @stormburger. The app shows their latest posts and reels.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: How do I stop texts or emails?
qa.a: Marketing texts and emails are opt-in. Reply STOP to a text or unsubscribe from an email at any time.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter at either location. I don't see a phone number in the app.
